title: Build agent memory with NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit and Amazon S3 Vectors
summary: Learn how to use Amazon S3 Vectors as the persistent memory layer within the NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit (NAT), deployed on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). This post shows how NAT's memory subsystem works and how to implement Amazon S3 Vectors as a custom memory pro
